plugin.name: Inline_Image_Transcript_Test
plugin.author: MUSHclient contributors
plugin.purpose: Verify inline-image transcript and link behavior against a local fixture

muclient.script: local seen_marker, checked = false, false local image_callbacks, image_triggers = 0, 0 local marker_time = 0 local output = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) .. '.results.txt' local function record(message) local f = assert(io.open(output, 'a')) f:write(message, '\n'); f:close() end function OnPluginInstall() local f = assert(io.open(output, 'w')); f:close() assert(AddTriggerEx('image_guard', '^\\[https?://.*\\]$', '', 41, -1, 0, '', 'ImageTrigger', 12, 100) == 0) record('START transcript test') end function ImageTrigger() image_triggers = image_triggers + 1 end function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if line:match('^%[https?://') then image_callbacks = image_callbacks + 1 end if line:find('INLINE_SUITE_END', 1, true) then seen_marker = true; marker_time = os.time() end return true end local function action_at(line, expected) for style = 1, GetLineInfo(line, 11) do if GetStyleInfo(line, style, 5) == expected then return true end end return false end local function check(condition, message) record((condition and 'PASS ' or 'FAIL ') .. message) if not condition then error(message) end end function OnPluginTick() if not seen_marker or checked or os.time() - marker_time < 4 then return end local images, after, text_link, image_tail = {}, nil, nil, nil for line = 1, GetLinesInBufferCount() do if GetLineInfo(line, 14) then if GetLineInfo(line, 18) == 0 then return end images[#images+1] = line end local text = GetLineInfo(line, 1) if text:find('AFTER_IMAGES', 1, true) then after = line end if text:find('Clickable text', 1, true) then text_link = line end if text:find('Image link tail', 1, true) then image_tail = line end end checked = true local ok, err = pcall(function() check(#images == 2, 'two image tags create exactly two transcript entries') check(image_callbacks == 0, 'image entries do not call received-line plugins') check(image_triggers == 0, 'image entries do not fire text triggers') for _, line in ipairs(images) do check(GetLineInfo(line, 18) == 1, 'image completed successfully') check(GetLineInfo(line, 16) == 640 and GetLineInfo(line, 17) == 240, 'image preserves intrinsic dimensions') check(GetLineInfo(line, 20) > 100, 'image occupies a variable-height transcript block') check(GetLineInfo(line+1, 19) == GetLineInfo(line, 19) + GetLineInfo(line, 20), 'following entry starts at image bottom') end check(after and after > images[2], 'text after images stays in stream order') check(text_link and action_at(text_link, 'text-clicked'), 'text command link retains its action') check(action_at(images[2], 'image-clicked'), 'image retains its enclosing command link') check(image_tail and action_at(image_tail, 'image-clicked'), 'enclosing command link resumes on text after image') check(after and not action_at(after, 'image-clicked'), 'image command link ends after its closing tag') local before = GetInfo(296) SetScroll(0, true) check(GetInfo(296) == 0, 'scroll-to-start uses pixel layout') SetScroll(-1, true) check(GetInfo(296) >= 0, 'scroll-to-bottom accepts image transcript') record('PASS transcript checks completed') end) if not ok then record('ERROR ' .. tostring(err)) end end
